statement: Intel holds roughly 13.7% of global 2.5D packaging capacity versus TSMC's around 70%, per figures cited in secondary coverage.
why: Even a fully working alternative packaging technology can only relieve the bottleneck in proportion to the capacity behind it, and Intel's share is a fraction of TSMC's.

impact.mechanism: With TSMC holding around 70% of 2.5D capacity, an Intel packaging win shifts a modest share of output and leaves overall accelerator supply gated by the incumbent.

evidence.source: TechSoda 'Global Market Watch: Advanced Packaging Takes the Stage' (Substack)
evidence.excerpt: Capacity share cited: Intel 'roughly 13.7% of global 2.5D packaging capacity', TSMC 'around 70%'.

confidence.basis: Secondary source (CryptoBriefing figures relayed inside a Substack post); no primary capacity disclosure.
